WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 THEN HGB / HCT END) AS avg_ratio,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
cross_patient_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
    WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_average_pic,
    AVG(p.avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    AVG(p.avg_ratio - c.average_ratio) AS mean_excess_ratio
FROM patient_averages p
CROSS JOIN cross_patient_average c
WHERE p.avg_ratio > c.average_ratio;
